name: Cen Link Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwanese enterprise Cen Link Co., Ltd. is engaged in the production and sale of electronic connectors. The company offers a wide spectrum of connector types, including those for batteries (such as battery holders and spring pins), pogo pins, machine pins, and both pin and female headers. Their product range further extends to various data and power interfaces like USB 2.0, mini and micro-USB, SATA, audio jacks, and DC power jacks. Other specialized connectors available include PAD, RJ jacks, card reader connectors, and box headers. Moreover, Cen Link provides custom-designed connectors tailored to specific client requirements. These vital components are integrated into a broad array of electronic applications, such as set-top boxes, LCD displays, mobile phones, digital video/still cameras (DV/DSC), and laptop computers. Established in 1981, Cen Link Co., Ltd. has its main office situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
